chosen_reward_amount.meaning: reward amount chosen by the user, just above the minimum-per-epoch threshold

fee_reduced_amount.meaning: reduction in tokens delivered to the Distributor caused by fees applied during campaign creation

campaign_created_as_compliant.meaning: campaign is created and passed off as compliant with the minimum reward-per-epoch invariant

real_per_epoch_below_minimum.meaning: the real per-epoch distribution actually delivered to the Distributor is below the minimum reward-per-epoch threshold
real_per_epoch_below_minimum.checkpoint: after fee deduction, at campaign creation

assumptions: The campaign creation call is the checked action; its trigger is implied by the PoC steps rather than stated explicitly.
The creator is treated as permissionless; no specific authorization state is reported.
The minimum reward-per-epoch invariant is the threshold referenced by the chosen amount.

unresolved.description: Exact fee rate and minimum reward-per-epoch threshold values are not given, so the numeric relation between chosen amount, fee reduction, and the minimum cannot be computed; the per-epoch-below-minimum condition is represented as a grounded Boolean.

limitations: The impact is stated as potential ('may lead to'), so the violation witness is a possibility rather than an asserted occurrence.
The pre-fee versus post-fee comparison is captured only qualitatively because no numeric fee or threshold is supplied.
Only the misleading_campaign_configurations impact is formalized here; other listed impacts are out of scope for this plan.
